indications: Clonidine hydrochloride tablets USP are indicated in the treatment of hypertension. Clonidine hydrochloride tablets USP may be employed alone or concomitantly with other antihypertensive agents.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Clonidine hydrochloride tablets USP 0.1 mg, yellow, round, debossed MP 657 on one side and plain on the other side.
                  Bottles of 100                        NDC 68071-3987-1
  
                  
                  Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F).
                  [See USP Controlled Room Temperature]
                  DISPENSE IN TIGHT, LIGHT-RESISTANT CONTAINER.
